description: This file is a script used for analyzing project source files to identify boundary violations related to plugin SDK imports and exports. It includes functions for collecting source files, parsing them with TypeScript, classifying module specifiers, and generating inventory reports to ensure compliance with import rules across different project modes.

methods.name: isCodeFile
methods.description: Checks if the filename matches common code file extensions (.ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs).

methods.name: collectExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects source code files from a root directory, excluding test-like files and non-code files.

methods.name: collectParsedExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Reads and parses collected source files into TypeScript SourceFile objects.

methods.name: resolveExtensionRoot
methods.description: Resolves the extension root directory based on the file path, relative to project structure.

methods.name: classifyReason
methods.description: Generates an explanatory string for why a particular module specifier or path is classified in a certain way, based on the mode and resolved path.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries for sorting purposes.

methods.name: shouldReport
methods.description: Determines whether a resolved path should be reported based on the current mode rules.

methods.name: collectEntriesByModeFromSourceFile
methods.description: Analyzes a source file to identify module specifier imports/exports and classifies them according to project boundary rules.

methods.name: collectExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Gathers the inventory of boundary violations within extension source files for a specified mode.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline inventory from a JSON file for comparison.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes the difference between expected and actual inventory entries.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory into a human-readable string report.

methods.name: runExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the boundary check, outputs results in JSON or human-readable formats, and compares against baseline.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that runs the boundary check process and handles process exit codes.
